crossRefs.note: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,
“Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.
“Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.

crossRefs.note: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are…

crossRefs.note: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

crossRefs.note: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea, have replenished.
He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you…
and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;
Then send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the children of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and…
because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains…
“Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre, and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay…
and Hamath, also, which borders on it; Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
